_source: Template for vault/script/deploy_sepolia.py (RISC Zero 3.1 programs of docs/image-ids.md). Fill from the LEZ side: lezConfig, the bridge program's configuration on the zone (its fields as the bridge's Init took them; vault = the address --expect-vault gives, evmChainId 11155111), and lezConfigId, its hash (ferrata-bridge-core encoding.rs: the tool recomputes it and refuses any other); genesisState, the zone's state at the tip the vault starts from (rule (B): the state over the zone's channel keys); nMin and tMin the zone's key set and threshold; checkpointImageIdB the checkpoint_b of the zone's Logos Blockchain layout (d480efc6: 0xdafa6ab9..., 0.3.5-rc.1 as LEZ v0.4.0-rc3 pins: 0x8917f58e...). The LEZ definitions are write-once at registration: set them to the LEZ side's token definition accounts.
